tei:div.tei:p: 179) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig las: mkha' 'gro dgongs pa 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs rgyun khyer yang zab snying po bzhugs: 180)na mo gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki ye: (Dakini secret letter here) gzhi dbyings gdod nas dag pa chos kyi sku: sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i lha: sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i bdag nyid rnal 'byor ma: rig stong mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gus pas 'dud: bsam gyis mi khyab yang gsang snying po'i bcud: mkha' 'gro 'bum kyi thugs bcud bla na med: las can skyes bu 'od skur smin pa'i thabs: yang gsang mkha' 'gro yongs 'dus sgrub pa ni: thugs dam rgyun khyer zab mo 'dir ru bstan: skal ldan chos brgyud 'dzin pas nyams su longs: sa ma ya: shin tu dben pa'i yid 'ong gnas chen du: grogs med gcig pur 'tshe ba bral ba'i sar: sgrub pa lhur len spros bcas rim 181)pa ni: mtshan ldan bhandha a mṛ ta yis bkang: gsang rdzas rnam gsum 'dud rtsi'i thabs kyis bsgyur: de stong skyon bral rin chen me long la: thabs kyi bsgyur ba'i gsang ba'i rdzas kyis ni: chos 'byung zur drug dga' 'khyil mtshan pa'i dbus: hrīḥbam̐ ha ri ni sa siddhi hūm̐: tsheg med dbu can g.yon 'khor tshul du bkod: le brgan dar gyis kha bkab da lar gzhug: phyi nang gsang mchod 'byor tshogs thams cad bshams: dkar phyogs srung mar gtor skyems la sogs bya: shin tu spros med rnal 'byor zab mo ni: lus dkyil dkyil 'khor chen po la brten nas: bsgrub pa'i snying po nyams su len par bya: sa ma ya: rnal 'byor pa sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las: dang po sngon 'gro 182)skyabs su 'gro ba ni: na mo: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dkon mchog gsum: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rtsa gsum lha: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i bdag nyid dpal: yongs 'dus ye shes mkha' 'gror skyabs su mchi: lan gsum dang: sems bskyed ni:

hoḥ 'di bzung byang chub snying po ma thob bar: ma gyur 'gro ba sems can kun don du: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i rim gnyis lam bsgom nas: smon 'jug don dam byang chub sems bskyed do: lan gsum gyis rang rgyud sbyangs: tshogs bsags yan lag bdun pa ni: hoḥ skye 'gags 'gyur med chos dbyings ngang nyid las: rang rig ma 'gags thugs rjes gzugs skur bzhengs: rnam kun mchog ldan don gyi rnal 'byor ma: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: bdag lus rdul snyed grangs mnyam rab sprul nas: rnamagasum dad pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal lo: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul te: snang srid kun bzang mchod pa'i phyag rgyar 'bul: the tshom dri mas yang dag don ma rtogs: gnas lugs rgyab kyis phyogs pa mthol lo bshags: 'gro rnams gtan bde'i byang chub la 'god phyir: bsod nams dge tshogs kun la rjes yi rang: khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can yongs grol gyi: 183)gang la gang 'dul theg gsum chos 'khor bskul: ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stongs par: de srid mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: zag bcas zag med rnam dkar dge tshogs kun: 'khor gsum dmigs bral byang chub chen por bsngo: 'gro rnams bla med sangs rgyas pa thob shog: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ de nas bka' bsgo ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ nga ni ye nas ngang gis khros: log 'dren 'byung po 'dul ba'i gshed: glo bur las byung gdon bgegs tshogs: nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed: 'dod yon glud gtor 'di longs la: gsang ba'i gnas 'dir ma 'dug par: da lta nyid du phyir dengs shig: gal te bka' las 'da' byed na: bdag nyid thugs las sprul pa yi: mtshon cha sna tshogs char ltar babs: rdul phran bzhin du brlag 'gyur ro: de bas da lta phyir dengs shig: hūm̐ hūm̐ u tsa ta ya phaṭaḥ thun gyis brab: hūm̐ bzhi dang drag sngags brjod nas gegs rnams rjes med du brlag par bsam:

de nas srung 'khor bsgom pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ chos nyid gzhi las ye shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul: gdangs snang ma 'gags 'do lnga'i rang bzhin duḥ rdo rje rein chen 184)padma rgya gram dang: 'khor lo me dpung mtshon cha sna tshogs 'phros: sra mkhregs rdo rje srung ba'i 'khor lo ni: rim pa brgyad du rang byung lhun gyis grub: gnyis 'dzin 'byung po'i gdon gyis glags mi rnyed: mi 'gyur rdo rje bsrung ba'i gur du gyur: oṃ badzra ratna padma karma tsakra tiksha dzwa la bhrūm̐ rakṣa rakṣa ye swā hāḥ de nas byin dbab pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ chos dbyings skye med dbyings kyi mkha': rang bzhin ye shes spyod pa'i ma: sku gsum mkha' 'gro yongs 'dus dpal: rdo rje phag mo rgyal ba'i yum: gtso dang 'khor gyi rnam pa ru: dbyings las ma g.yos gzugs skur bzhengs: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen phobs: snang ba gzhi ru sbyong ba dang: yul snang zhing khams byin chen phobs: snang srid gzugs snang thams cad kun: lha dang lha mor byin chen phobs: 'byung ba lnga yi sgra grags skad: chos nyid rang sgrar byin= dran rtog sems kyi 'gyu 'phro kun: spros bral gzhi ru byin= dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i rdzas yo byad: zag med bdud rtsir byin= sgrub mchog sgo gsum smin pa dang: rdo rje gsum du byin chen phobs: dbang chen rnams kyis dbang bskur la: byin chen rnams kyis byin phob cig: bgegs dang 185) bar chad mi mthun sel: mchog dag thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru badzra dzñā na ḍā ki ni bha ra ka li ho hūm̐ bam̐ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrīḥya sarba sa ma ya e a ra li pheṃ pheṃ a we sha ya āḥ de nas mchod rdzas byin brlab ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: snang srid dpal yon ji snyed kun: mchod pa'i rdzas mchog bla na med: ting nge 'dzin las rab sprul pas: phyi nang gsang mchod bsam mi khyab: kun bzang mchod sprin lta bu ru:

ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs te: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes pa'i rdzas: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs: shapda ru pa sogs: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta ma hā su kha bho dhi tsitta sarba pū dza āḥhūm̐: de nas dngos gzhi lha yi ting nge 'dzin ni: āḥ spros bral rig pa chos kyi sku: skye 'gags 'gyur med gdod nas dag: rnam kun mchog ldan ngo bo nyid: ngang gnas chen po de bzhin nyid: hūm̐: lhun grub snang ba ma 'gags pa'i: snang srid rang byung chen por rdzogs: kun khyab ye shes byang chub sems: ma bsgom rang gsal snying rjer shar: hrīḥ rang byung ye shes 186)rol pa'i rtsal: rgyu yi sa bon yi ge bam̐: dkyil 'khor rten dang brten pa'i lha: rgyu ru rang byung lhun gyis grub: hūm̐ badzra tsitta āḥ bam̐ḥlas 'od 'phros snod bcud sbyangs: 'byung lnga rnam dag yum lnga'i klong: bhrūm̐ las rin chen gzhal yas khang: tshad dang mtshan nyid ma lus kun: yongs grub chen por lhun gyis grub: brda don rtags gsum rdzogs pa'i dbus: pad nyi zla gdan bam̐ gyi steng: rang rig bam las 'od zer 'phros: rgyal mchod 'gro ba'i nyes skyon sbyangs: tshur 'dus yongs gyur skad cig gis: rang nyid gsang ba ye shes ma: rdo rje phag mo sku mdog mthing: zhal gcig spyan gsum dbyings su gzigs: phyag bzhi dang po gnyis kyis ni: ral gri rtse gsum g.yas g.yon gdengs: 'og gnyis thugs kar gri thod 'dzin: dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'khyil: thod skam rin chen rtse bran mdzes: nyi zla'i snyan rgyan 'od du 'bar: spyi bor phag zhal nag po ngur: sku la dur khrod chas kun rdzogs: zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba: pad nyi bam ro'i gdan la 'gying: ye shes me phung 'khyil ba'i klong: snang la rang bzhin med par bsgoms: 187)spyi bor rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma: dkar mo zhal gcig spyan gsum ldan:

phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: sku la mkha' 'gro'i chas kun rdzogs: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum tshul du ni: rang snang yab dang gnyis med 'khril: rgya gram bam ro'i gdan la bzhugs: rdo rje rigs kyi 'khor gyis bskor: mgrin par padma mkha' 'gro ma: dmar gsal zhal= phyag gnyis= sku la khro mo'i rgyan chas rdzogs: zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pas: rang snang yab= padma bam ro'i= padma rigs kyi= snying gar sangs rgyas= mthing skya zhal= phyag gnyis= sku la mkha' 'gro'i= zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum yab dang 'khril: 'khor lo bam ro'i gdan= 'khor du sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i sras: sangs rgyas rigs kyi 'khor gyis bskor: lte bar rin chen= ser gsal zhal= phyag gnyis gri= zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum tshul du ni: rang snang yab= ratna bam ro'i= rin chen rigs kyi= gsang bar las kyi= ljang gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: g.yas pas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar: phyag g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzinaḥ sku la khro mo'i chas kun 188) rdzogs: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum tshul du ni: rang snang yab dang gnyis med rol: ral gri bam ro'i gdan la bzhugs: las kyi rigs kyi 'khor gyis bskor: ye shes 'od kyi rtsa bzhi'i dbus: padma nyi zla bam ro'i steng: 'byung bzhi dag pa'i mkha' 'gro bzhi: rang snang yab dang gnyis med par: sku mdog phyag mtshan rnam 'gyur ni: rang gsal der 'dzin bral ba yi: sgyu ma chu zla ji bzhin gsal: yan lag sgo ba yab yum dang: gzhan yang grangs can grangs med kyi: rtsa khams rlung thig rdo rje'i grong: gnas yul nyer bzhi sum cu dang: dur khrod brgyad dang he ru'i gnas: rang byung rnam dag pho brang na: bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dkyil dang 'khor gyi rnam pa ru: rtsa gnas dag pa'i grong khyer du: sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i sprin du shar: sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs: ma nges rnam 'gyur sna tshogs gar: sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul ji bzhin du:

ma 'dres yongs rdzogs chen po'o: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las: 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros: rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing la phog: rgyal kun thugs rgyud rab bskul nas: ye shes sems dpa'i rnam pa ru: spyan drangs 189) gnyis su med par bstim: de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min chos dbyings gsang chen rol pa nas: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro yongs kyi spyi dpal mo: rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: skye med chos sku'i klong nas ma g.yos kyang: log 'dren 'dul phyir khro mo'i skur bzhengs lha: dkyil dang 'khor gyi rnam par shar ba kun: ma lus gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: 'khor 'das dbang du sdud phyir= log 'dren bdud dpung 'dul phyir= rnal 'byor byin gyis brlab phyir= mchog thun dngos grub stsol phyir= oṃ gu ru badzra dzñā na ḍā ki ni bha ra ka li he hūṃ bam̐ ha ri ni sa sarba badzra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ de nas bzhugs gsol ni: hūm̐ hrī: ye shes dbyings nas gshegs pa'i lha tshogs rnams: dam tshig dang ni ye shes dbyer med pa: snang ba thabs kyis bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: stong nyid shes rab rtsal las rang byung ba'i: zung 'jug nyi zla padma'i gdan steng du: gnyis med ro gcig ngang du bzhugs su gsol: badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ tiṣṭha lhan: de nas brda phyag 'tshal ba ni: na mo: chos sku skye ba med pa'i ngang nyid las: rang bzhin ma 'gags lhun grub longs 190)skur shar: thugs rjes gang 'dul mdzad pa'i skur ston pa: lhan skyes ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la: brda dang brda lan tshul gyis ye phyag 'tshal: na mo na ma hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ting 'dzin yid las rab sprul pa'i: snang srid yongs bkang mchod pa'i sprin: sems kyi rang bzhin gter chen po: kun brtags snang ba'i dbang lnga'i yul: gzhan dbang srid pa'i 'dod yon ni:

phyi nang gsang ba de nyid kyi: mchod pa'i bye brag bsam mi khyab: bkra shis rdzas rtags rin chen bdun: lha klu mi yi dpal 'byor kun: yongs grub rig pa'i rgyan du shar: mkha' 'gro ma yi dkyil 'khor du: blang dor med pa'i mnyes mchod 'bul: bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs: shapda rū pa shapda gandhe ra sa sparshe sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta ma hā sarba ta na gha ṇa bho dhi tsitta ma hā su kha sarba pū dza khā hiḥ de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral kun bzang chos kyi sku: 'gags med rang byung lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs: thugs rje sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs rnal 'byor ma: gar dgu'i nyams ldan bdud dpung zil gyis gnon: rdo rje phag mo'i sku gsung thugs yon tan: phrin las 191)lnga la sgo gsum gus pas bstod: gzhan yang ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du: 'khod cing gang 'dul mdzad pa'i skur ston pa: dkyil dang 'khor gyi rnam par shar ba'i lha: rab 'byams phrin las mchog la mnga' brnyes pa: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas bshags pa ni: hoḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du: bdag ni ma rig skyon dbang gis: bskyed bzlas ting 'dzin g.yel ba dang: sgo gsum bag med las ci bgyis: gnong 'gyod drag pos mthol zhing bshags: dag cing tshangs par mdzad du gsol: oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya sogs: āḥ de nas yang snying 'dzab dgongs ni: hūm̐: rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka ru: chos 'byung dga' 'khyil dbus su ni: dwangs ma lnga yi 'od klong du: thugs srog bam̐ yig mthing ga'i mthar: sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor ba las: 'od zer yar 'phros rgyal kun mchod: thugs rje gzi byin nus mthu bsdus: mar 'phros 'gro ba'i nyes skyon sbyangs: tshe bsod dbang bsdus bde la bkod: 'khor 'das srog bcud ma lus kun: tshur 'dus srog gi snying por bstim:

snang grags rig pa chos sku'i 192)ngang: rnam dag lha yi dal du rdzogs: gtso 'khor srog sngags ro gcig bzlas: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥgu ru badzra ḍā ki ni bha ra ka li he hūm̐ bam̐ ha ri ni sa sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ smra bcad mi tshig ma 'dres par: bzla che gzer gsum dang ldan na: bye ba gcig gis 'grub par 'gyur: rtags mtshan lag tu longs dang gsal: me tog tshal phyin dung 'gron rnyed: dkar gsum mngar gsum longs su spyod: dngul dkar me long snyed pa ni: rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'grub pa'i rtags: dung 'bud rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa dang: ba dan 'phyar dang ri rtser 'grim: rin chen sna tshogs rnyed pa sogs: rin chen mkha' 'gro 'grub pa'i rtags: utpal dmar po'i tshal du phyin: gzhon nu ma yis bkur bsti byed: mtshan ldan bhandha chang gis bkang: nus ldan ro mchog ster ba dang: bde ba'i gar dang sgyu rtsal ngoms: brda chos ma nges sna tshogs shar: padma mkha' 'gro 'grub pa'i rtags: brag shing bcom dang gzhan bran bkol: mi min lha 'dre 'bangs su gyur: mtshan ldan bam ro rnyed pa ni: karma mkha' 'gro 'grub pa'i rtags: lha zhal mjal du mkha' la 'phur: sku gsung thugs kyi rten gang rung: rnyed nas byin brlabs gsung 'byon dang: rang byung dgongs pa klong rdol sogs: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro 'grub pa'i rtags: rang lus gnas dag 'od du shar: rtsa gnas thams cad yi ge dang: sgra grags rtsa ba'i sngags kyi sgra: bar med rang bzhin ngang du grags: 193) rig pa mi 'gyur thugs su smin: chos nyid don la som nyi bral: chos kun mnyam nyid chen por rdzogs: mchog gi mkha' 'gro 'grub pa'i rtags: de nas rab 'bring tha ma gang: rnal 'byor rang rang dpal du shar: gang la zhen pa'i 'phri ba spongs: gnyis 'dzin re dogs ma byed par: rig pa'i rtsal du shes par gyis: mchog thun dngos grub thor par nges: 'di ni mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi: srog sgrub yang zab snying po mchog:

gang 'brel rnam grol lam 'god nges: the tshom med do sa ma ya: gab pa gnad kyi byang gcig ni: rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas: me dpung mtshon thun pho nya 'phros: mtha' yi du ru sde bzhi dang: log 'dren 'byung po thams cad kun: me dpung mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis: rjes shul tsam yang med par brlag: rnam par shes par dbyings su bsgral: 'khrul mi shes pa'i sa ru phaṭaḥ rtsa sngags mthar: du ru tsa ka tshindha ke mā ri dgra bgegs sarba shā truṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ khri phrag bcu yis 'grub par 'gyur: man ngag zab mo i thi rgya: shin tu gsang chen snying po'i don: bcud bsdus rgyas gdab bzhi yi gnad: 'ja' lus gdams pa'i bcud bsdus ni: skad cig phag mo mthing ga bsgom: 'khor lo 194)lnga dbus rigs lnga yi: yab yum gsal gdab rtsa gsum dbus: sku gsum mtshon byed 'bru gsum ni: dkar dmar mthing ga'i rnam par gsal: sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i a shad la: ye shes rlung gi nus pa'i mthus: me mched spyi bor zla ba'i rgyun: 'od zhu rim bzhin gnas lnga yi: dkyil 'khor rtsa gnas thams cad mchod: dga' ba gsum gyi 'od gsal la: brten nas bzhi pa'i ye shes mthong: rdo rje 'od kyis rtsa sbyangs nas: dwangs ma'i rang bzhin sku ru 'pho: phra rags rtsa mdud thams cad grol: 'byung 'jug rdo rje gsum du 'gyur: rlung sngags dbyer med bde ba che: gsal la rtog med ye shes lnga: de la rim bzhin gnad goms pas: drod rtags thams cad ngang gis 'char: rlung sems dbyer med dbu mar zhugs: gang yang chos nyid 'dus ma byas: ye shes 'khor lor 'byams klas pa: 'khor ba ma spangs gzhi la sangs: 'das pa bsgrub med ngo bor sad: 'gyu 'phro'i rtog tshogs rgyun chad nas: rang byung lha yi phyag rgyar 'phos: gnas gsum 'od thig dkar dmar mthing: sgrib bral shin ru dwangs pa'i dbus: rdo rje'i yi ge 'bru gsum ni: 'od dang 'od zer tshul du bsgom:

lus ngag sems kyi sgrib pa ni: 'bru gsum nus pas rab tu sbyangs: slar yang oṃ yig thig le bcas: āḥl bsdu zhing āḥyig ni: thig le'i rnam par hūm̐ la bsdus: de dag dkar dmar mthing ga yi: 'od thig nyungs 'bru tsam du gyur: de yi khong gseng 195)'bru gsum ni: shin tu phra ba'i rnam par gsal: gcig dril hūṃ la sems gtad nas: yengs med 'dzin med ngang du zhog: de la shin tu goms pas na: ma dag rtsa thig rlung gsum dag: mi shigs rdo rje gsum dang 'dres: lha yi sku gsung thugs su smin: slar yang bcud 'dus thig le rnams: 'od zhu 'od kyis phyi nang gi: snod bcud rgyu rkyen ma lus sbyangs: thams cad stong nyid chen por gyur: stong pa'i rang gdangs ma 'gags pa'i: 'od gsal chen po'i ye shes ngang: mngon gyur dbyings dang rig pa gnyis: dbyer med chos sku'i nyams len la: rtse gcig gnad du bsnun pas na: zag bcas sgyu ma'i phung po 'di: zag med 'od kyi sku ru smin: phung po mi snang 'od du mthong: nyon mongs yul zad ye shes ngang: rkyen snang thams cad chos skur grol: las rlung g.yos ba'i cho 'phrul rnams: stobs chen ye shes rlung du gyur: sems dang sems byung rtog tshogs kun: rang grol rig pa chos sku'i ngang: gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang: mngon gyur dang po'i sangs rgyas te: ji srid 'khor ba gnas kyi bar: de srid phrin las rgyun mi chad: sa ma ya: 'di ni 'od lus bsgrub pa'i thabs: ḍā ka'i rgya mtsho'i thugs bcud 'di: rdzogs rim mang pos do zla min : nyung bsdus gcig dril gdams pa zab: gang zag skal ldan sems kyi bus: rtse gcig nyams su len 196)nus na: pad 'byung bdag gi bka' mi bslu: 'ja' lus 'grub par the tshom med: bskyed rdzogs grangs la ltos mi dgos: 'di nyid gcig pu nyams blangs na: mchog kun dngos grub thob par 'gyur: the tshom med do sa ma ya:

rjes rim bsod nams gsog pa'i thabs: bza' dang bca' ba btung ba'i rigs: 'byor tshogs mchod pa'i rdzas ji sked: sha chang la sogs tshad ldan bshams: de nas byin gyis brlab pa ni: rang nyid lha yi ting 'dzin gyis: byin gyis brlab pa 'di skad do: oṃ: bde chen padma bhandha'i snod: yangs shing rgya che'i nang du ni: āḥlas snang dang srid pa'i chos: 'dod yon longs spyod bsam mi khyab: hūm̐ gis ye shes bdud rtsi'i sprin: rgyal kun mnyes pa'i rdzas su spel: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum dang mchod pa'i sprin gzungs nam mkha' mdzod sngags brjod: de nas tshogs phud rim pa bdun du bkod: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang snang rnam dag 'og min zhing: dpa' bo dpa' mo 'du ba'i gnas: gsang chen rol pa'i gnas mchog nas: sku gsum mkha' 'gro yongs kyi rje: rdo rje phag mo rgyal ba'i yum: dkyil dang 'khor gyi rnam pa ru: 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs: dbu skra thor cog ldems se ldem: dar dpyangs 197)dril g.yer pu ru ru: me long rus pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes: dpa' bos bro brdung khrabs se khrab: dpa' mos glu gar chems se chem: phaṭa dang pheṃ sgra sangs se sang: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: zhabs gnyis gar stabs shigs se shig: byin rlabs na bun thibs se thib: dngos grub bdud rtsi nyi li li: 'dod yon gsang rdzas tshogs la rol: dam rdzas bā liṃ māṃ sa dang: dza gad dpa' bo thod rnga'i sgra: rol mo snyan dbyangs bshugs pa'i glu: pi waṃ gling bu sgra snyan bcas: rnam gsum dag pa'i mchod pa 'di: rgyal yum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: sku gsung thugs kyi dam nyams bshags: gnyis 'dzin lam gol dbyings su sgrol: mchog thun su kha'i dngos grub stsol: nang ltar rdo rje lus kyi grong: dpa' bo dpa' mo 'du ba'i gnas: spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus: me long ye shes ngo bo nyid: rang bzhin ye shes spyod pa'i ma:

rdo rje mkha' 'gro rgyal ba'i yum: rdo rje rigs kyi 'khor dang bcas: 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs: dbu skra thor cog sogs: dngos grub stsol: mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo na: sor rtogs ye shes ngo bo nyid: rang bzhin 198) ye shes spyod pa'i ma: padma mkha' 'gro rgyal ba'i yum: padma rigs kyi 'khor dang bcas: 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs: dbu skra thor cog sogs: dngos grub stsol: snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo na: chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid: rang bzhin ye shes spyod pa'i ma: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro rgyal ba'i yum: sangs rgyas rigs kyi 'khor dang bcas: 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs: dbu skra thor cog sogs: dngos grub stsol: lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo na: mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid: rang bzhin ye shes spyod pa'i ma: rin chen mkha' 'gro rgyal ba'i yum: rin chen rigs kyi 'khor dang bcas: 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs: dbu skra thor cog sogs: dngos grub stsol: gsang ba bde skyong 'khor lo na: bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid: rang bzhin ye shes spyod pa'i ma: las kyi mkha' 'gro rgyal ba'i yum: las kyi rigs kyi 'khor dang bcas: 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs: dbu skra thor cog sogs: dngos grub stsol: gzhan yang rdo rje rtsa yi grong: nyi shu rtsa bzhi yul sum cu: he ru ka yi gnas bcu sogs: rang bzhin bzhugs pa'i rnal 'byor ma: dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: sgo skyong pho nya las byed 199)bcas: dkyil dang 'khor gyi rnam pa ru: 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs: dbu skra thor cog sogs: dngos grub stsol: de nas bskang bshags ni: hoḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag ni ma rig gti mug rkyen dbang gis: gzung 'dzin gnyis snang 'khor bar 'khyams pa yis: bdag med bdag tu bzung ba'i sgrib pa kun:

'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyis bskang zhing bshags: skye med chos dbyings ngang du bzod gsol nas: dag tshangs mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: gzhan phan chung zhing zhe sdang rkyen gyur pa'i: 'gro drug sems can don la blo zhan pas: snying rje chung zhing don ma bgyis pa sogs: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyis bskang zhing bshags: me long ye shes klong du bzod= dag tshangs= nyon mongs nga rgyal dbang du gyur pa yis: rdo rje slob dpon mched dang lcam dral gyi: sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba'i las ci bsags: 'dod yon= mnyam nyid ye shes klong= dag tshangs= nyon mongs 'dod chags dbang du gyur pas na: gtong phod chung zhing ser sna 'jur gegs kyis: lo dang zla ba nya stong dus mchod chags: 'dod yon= 200) skyon bral dri med ngang du bzod= dag tshangs= nyon mongs phrag dog dbang du= rang rgyal phyogs ris bzung ba'i kun slong gis: grogs mched thugs dang 'gal ba'i las ci bgyis: 'dod yon= bya grub ye shes klong du= dag tshangs= thabs la ma mkhas dbang du gyur pas na: phud lhag nyams dang kha tshar shor ba dang: tshor dang ma tshor nyams chags ci bsags pa: 'dod yon= dag chen chos dbyings klong du= sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya sogs: āḥ yig brgya lan gsum dang: bsgral bstabs ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ bdag med lta ba'i he ru kas: bdag lta'i ru tra bsgral ba'i phyir: dbyings nas skur bzhengs nyams pa'i dgra: dmigs pa'i rten dang gnyis med khug: dug gsum rtsad gcod phur bu yis: gzas po'i lus ngag yid la gdab: rnam shes skye med dbyings su phaṭaḥ zag phung ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur: rtsa gsum lha yi zhal du bstab: 'khrul snang ye shes sa ru sgrol: sarba shā truṃ mā ra ya khā hiḥ de nas dngos grub rol pa ni: hoḥ thabs shes gnyis med gsang ba'i rdzas: mchog gi dngos grub 201)bla na med: gtsang rme gnyis 'dzin rtog pa bral:

tshims pa drug ldan ngang du rol: a la la hoḥ de nas lhag ma 'bul ba ni: pheṃ bhyo: dpal chen bka' nyan dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong: dbang phyug mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis dang: ging dang lang ka shugs 'gro gnas nyul sde: lhag la dbang ba'i pho nya rgya mcho'i tshogs: lhag gtor pha phog bzang po 'di bzhes la: phyi nang bar chad mi mthun rgud pa sol: rnam bzhi'i bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: u tstshiṣṭa ba liṃ ta khā hiḥ lag gtor gtsang sar phyi rol du 'bul: de nas thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: bzhengs shig mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i lha: ma g.yel thugs dam gnad nas bskul: chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs la: sgyu 'phrul rol rtsal sna tshogs kyis: bstan dang bstan 'dzin la gnod pa'i: log 'dren 'byung po bdud kyi rigs: byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad rnams: thal ba rdul du brlag par mdzod: dus las ma 'da' sa ma ya: de nas chad tho ni: hūm̐ bhyo: dus gsum las 'das ka dag kun tu bzang: spyi dpal che mchog he ru ka dpal gyi: spyan sngar 202)tha tshig khas blangs dam bcas pa'i: bka' sdod dam can stobs ldan srung ma'i tshogs: rang rang las byed pho nya sprul pa bcas: 'dir gshegs chad mdo dmar gyi gtor ma longs: gsang sngags bstan srungs bstan 'dzin sku tshe srings: mtha' 'dre'i cho 'phrul rdzas ngan nus pa choms: rgya 'dre bdud bgegs kla klo'i gnod pa bzlog: sangs rgyas bstan pa dar rgyas phrin las mdzod: gzhan yang rig 'dzin rdo rje thod phreng dang: brgyud ldan rig 'dzin bla ma yan chad kyi: bka' dang tha tshig la gnas dregs pa'i tshogs: 'khor bcas pa ma lus 'dir gshegs la: chad mdo dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon gyi tha tshig g.yar dam ji bzhin du: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad rkyen ngan bzlog: zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i las rab 'byams: rten 'brel bzhin du yongs 'grub phrin las mdzod: de nas brtan ma skyong pa ni:

bhyo: dpal gyi bka' nyan bod khams skyong ba'i ma: brtan ma bcu gnyis ya ma skyong ma'i tshogs: 'dir gshegs bshal chu gtor ma 'di longs la: sngon gyi g.yar dam gnyen po'i tha tshig bzhin: sangs rgyas bstan srungs dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod: mtha' mi ha ra nag po'i bstan pa 203)snubs: rgyal bstan dar zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: ma ma hring hreing la la ling ling ta ta ting ting ba liṃ ta khā hiḥ de nas rta bro brdung ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: bar du gcod pa'i bdud bgegs dam sri kun: 'gyur med ri rab chen po'i 'og tu mnan: rtsal snang ye shes rol pa'i bro brdungs te: 'chor med las kyi phyag rgya bzhi yis bcings: nyams pa nam yang ldang bar ma gyur cig: oṃ laṃ: āḥlaṃ: hūm̐ laṃ: st+waṃ bha ya nan: de nas mchod bstod bya zhing dngos grub ni: hoḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro sgrub pa'i dam tshig thems: gsang gsum dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la babs: mi gnas ye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: nad gdon 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i dngos grub stsol: tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i= khams gsum snang ba dbang sdud= dgra bgegs tshar gcod drag po'i= mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus kun: deng 'dir sgrub mchog bdag la bstsal du gsol: oṃ dzñā na ḍā ki ni bha ra ka li he hūm̐ bam̐ ha ri ni sa kā ya siddhi oṃ: wākka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐: sarba siddhi hrīḥ zhes 204)brjod sgrub rdzas gnas gsum la gtugs nas rol zhing dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam: de nas nongs bshags ni: hoḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du: rten dang brten par bcas pa dgongs: bdag ni ma rig bag med pas: bskyed bzlas ting 'dzin g.yel ba dang: sgo gsum dam nyams ci bsags pa: 'gal 'khrul ci mchis bzod par gsol: oṃ badzra satwa sogs: āḥ lan gsum brjod nas rdzogs rim ni:

hūm̐: thabs kyis bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: chos dbyings stong pa'i ngang du muṃ: rjes thob mkha' las glog 'gyu bzhin: snang rtog lha yi phyag rgyar shar: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: de nas bsngo smon ni: hoḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du: rim gnyis lam mchog bsgoms pa dang: dus gsum dge rtsa ci bsags pa: ma gyur 'gro ba yongs la bsngo: kun kyang byang chub sangs rgyas shog: bdag cag sgrub pa'i mched lcam rnams: mi 'bral tshom bu gcig tu ni: mkha' 'gro ma yis rjes bzung nas: mi gnas gtan srid zin par shog: de nas bkra shis ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma'i byin rlabs mkha' la sprin ltar 'khrigs: yi dam lha yi dngos grub char ltar bsnyil: mkha' 'gro rgya 205)mtsho'i phrin las glog ltar myur: gsang sngags zab mo'i bstan pa phyogs mthar rgyas: rtsa gsum lha yi bkra shis dam pa 'di: deng 'dir sgrub mchog rnams la legs stsal nas: snang rtog thams cad lha yi phyag rgyar rdzogs: sgra grags thams cad bde chen sngags su dag: dran rtog 'od gsal mi 'gyur thugs su smin: 'ja' lus gzhon nu bum sku'i bkra shis shog: gzhan yang bkra shis ci rigs brjod: me tog 'thor nas rgyas gdab bya: las rjes mi mngon gsang ba gnad: sa ma ya: e ma: gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba: man ngag zab chos kun gyi mchog: yang gsang mkha' 'gro sgrub pa'i thabs: padma sambha'i thugs dam mthil: ma rgyud ḍā ki'i srog gi bcud: snying mig srog las phangs na yang: phyi rabs las can skyes bu'i don: ye shes mtsho rgyal khyod la gtad: rin chen 'khrul gyi gter du sbos: ma 'ongs dus kyi mar gsham la: mi rnams log lam 'dud kyi brlabs: nad mug mtshon gyi bskal pa dar: mtha' mi ha ras gnod pa brtsams: rdzas ngan cho 'phrul sa steng gang: gsang sngags bstan pa dar rgud mang: chos bzhin spyod pa nyin skar tsam: chos min log lam rang gis bsgrub: 'byung ba dgrar langs srog la 'tshe:

nga yi thugs rjes ma skyob na: dus ngan rang mtshangs rang gis ston: de dus khyod sprul kun dga' 206)dang: tā re su kha di paṃ sogs: nga sprul grogs dang 'phrad nas kyang: chos 'dis don gnyis 'byung bar nges: bka' srung sha za ḍā kis srungs: skal ldan bu dang 'phrad par shog: skal med rnams la 'di ma sprod: dregs pa rnam gsum gnyer gyis shig: ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga yi dus: gter spyod tha mal gzugs su 'ong: gces pa'i nor bzhin de la sprod: dus la babs tshe gtad rgya khrol: dam nyams lag tu ma shor ba: thub par srungs shig sa ma ya: sku rgya: gsung rgya: thugs rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gu hya: brda thim: : ces rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro yongs 'dus kyi sgrub thabs 'di yang o rgyan mtsho skyes rdo rje dang rnam dbyer ma mchis pa mtshan brjod par dka' na'ang don gyi slad du rig 'dzin 'gro 'dul dpa' bo rdo rjes bka' gnang stsal ba la brten nas/ zhag cha shas tsam song skabs sbas gnas rdo rje yang rdzong phug mo che nas 'ongs ba yin zer ba'i bud med mdzes ma zhig gis mkha' 'gro zab sgrub kyi brda red/ 'tshubs slong che rung rten 'brel thog ma yin pas go'am zer nas thal/ gtad rgya btsan thabs su sad pa'i rten 'brel dus la babs tshe rigs sras dam pa rig 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rje dang*/ kun bzang 'chi med dbang mo zung gis bka' bskul nan cher phebs tshe 'khor 'bangs yongs kyi tha shal ba su kha badzra gyis mkha' 'gro'i brda las dag par bris pa yongs su dge bar gyur cig/ dge'o//
